game_blurb: Destroy the Flag is a fast-paced multiplayer party-shooter: teams throw bombs (knockback, freezing, haste) to defend their flag and destroy the enemy's, while a 3-phase match escalates into an optional 'Chaos Mode' that throws giant meteors, bouncing balls, freezing ice trails, and thrown knives into the arena. Built in Godot. Currently in Steam Playtest.
cta: Sign up for the free Steam Playtest by following the link in the pinned post above (quoted by this post) and requesting access.

screenshots.desc: A team's home base: a flag on a pole standing in a stylized low-poly kitchen-themed arena.
A player sprinting across the map early in a match, with the Phase 1 'Flags Invulnerable' countdown bar at the top of the screen.
Chaotic mid-fight combat with multiple bombs (knockback/freeze/haste) in the air at once.
Chaos Mode's 'Meteor' random event: a giant glowing meteor slowly descending toward the arena before it slams down and knocks everyone into the air.
Chaos Mode's 'Bounces' random event: oversized volleyballs and basketballs ricocheting around the arena, knocking back anyone they hit.
Chaos Mode's 'Freezer' random event: sliding ice cubes that leave a glowing frozen trail on the ground - stand on it too long and you get frozen solid.
Chaos Mode's 'Knife Throwing' random event: a giant spinning knife hovers in the air before launching itself straight at the nearest player.
